title: Bounded-below continuity of constructible derived internal Hom
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension, and $X$ a scheme whose underlying topological space is Noetherian, meaning that every descending chain of closed subsets stabilizes. Let $\Lambda$ be $\underline{\mathcal O_E}$ or $\underline E$ [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], put $B=\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and use the ordinary uncompleted derived category $D(\operatorname{Mod}_B)$ [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], namely the unbounded localization of cochain complexes of $B$-modules at quasi-isomorphisms. Let $K$ be a complex with bounded cohomology constructible in the finite constant local model sense [sk-def-sfb-constructible]: its cohomology vanishes outside a finite interval, and each cohomology sheaf admits a finite constructible stratification with finite constant local models as in [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Let $I$ be a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and let $(M_i^\bullet)_{i\in I}$ be a diagram of cochain complexes of $B$-module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] with one common termwise lower bound $c\in\mathbf Z$: $M_i^r=0$ for all $i$ and $r<c$. Write $M=\varinjlim_iM_i^\bullet$ for the termwise sheaf colimit. Then the evaluation-induced canonical map
$$
\varinjlim_i R\mathcal Hom_B(K,M_i^\bullet)
\longrightarrow R\mathcal Hom_B(K,M)
$$
[sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom] is an isomorphism in $D(\operatorname{Mod}_B)$. On the left, filtered colimit means the exact termwise sheaf colimit of functorial complex representatives of derived internal Hom; equivalently the assertion is that the canonical maps on all cohomology sheaves are isomorphisms. It is independent of quasi-isomorphic choices of representatives. No constructibility or completeness is required of the $M_i^\bullet$.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.12 and the argument of Lemma 6.3.14; the internal-sheaf, filtered-colimit version is an additional local devissage claim, not a verbatim statement of the global direct-sum lemma. See also the local support argument of Lemma 6.7.13.

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-module-object-ringed-site-derived-comparison] work in ordinary ringed-site models preserving evaluation. Use the property $P$ of [lem-sfb-rhom-continuity-triangle-closure], which includes a diagram-independent lower bound. Exact filtered colimits [lem-pur-ringed-site-grothendieck-abelian] commute with cohomology by applying exactness to the kernel/image sequences of each differential; hence they preserve quasi-isomorphisms and commute with the smart truncation having $\operatorname{coker}d^{c-1}$ in degree $c$. Thus uniformly cohomologically bounded targets may be replaced functorially by termwise bounded targets. The model invariance of [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] justifies these choices.

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-finite-local-model-rhom-continuity], $P_T(L[0])$ holds with bound $d_L=0$ for every finite constant local model $L$ on every scheme $T$, including integral torsion models.

source.place: Tag 08JI; returned step 2 is now the cited local-model lemma.

proof.text: Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be closed with open complement and $T$ topologically Noetherian. By [lem-sfb-closed-support-bounded-continuity], $Ri^!$ commutes with our colimits and preserves their common lower bound. The functor $Ri^!=R\underline\Gamma_Z$ of [lem-sfb-open-closed-internal-hom-formulas] and the $Ri^!$ of [lem-sfb-closed-support-bounded-continuity] are both right adjoints of $i_*$ on bounded-below objects, so they are canonically isomorphic by uniqueness of adjoints, compatibly with the counits; we identify them. The closed formula [lem-sfb-open-closed-internal-hom-formulas] then gives $R\mathcal Hom_T(i_*L,N_i)\cong i_*R\mathcal Hom_Z(L,Ri^!N_i)$. Step 2 applies on $Z$. Closed $i_*$ is exact and commutes with filtered colimits by [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed]; its qcqs hypothesis follows from [lem-sfb-noetherian-space-compact-subsets]. The natural formulas therefore prove $P_T(i_*L)$ with bound zero.

source.place: Lemma 6.7.13, internal support calculation; returned steps 3–4.

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-rhom-continuity-open-extension], every open $v:V\hookrightarrow X$ carries sources with $P_V$ to sources with $P_X$. Apply this to the sources $t_*L$ of step 3 inside $V$. Every open subspace of the Noetherian space $X$ is Noetherian, so the hypotheses hold. Thus $P_X(v_!t_*L)$ for every generator used below.

The class of sources with $P_X$ contains zero and is closed under isomorphisms, shifts and triangles by [lem-sfb-rhom-continuity-triangle-closure]. Apply [lem-sfb-bounded-finite-model-generation] and step 4: all its generators have $P_X$, so the given bounded constructible $K$ has $P_X$.

The given diagram has the common termwise lower bound $c$, hence also the common cohomological bound required by $P_X(K)$. Its comparison is therefore an isomorphism. All comparison maps above are evaluation-induced. Exact filtered colimits preserve the quasi-isomorphisms of the models, by step 1, giving the asserted independence; by [lem-weil-pbc-unbounded-derived-iso-cohomology] a morphism of $D(\operatorname{Mod}_B)$ is an isomorphism exactly when it is so on all cohomology sheaves, which is the equivalent cohomology-sheaf formulation.

lean.statement: theorem constructible_internalHom_continuity (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (X : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X] (Λ : Mon (Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})) [IsCommMonObj Λ.X] (_hΛ : Λ = Mon.mk (FiniteConstantModel.integralCoefficients l E) ∨ Λ = Mon.mk (FiniteConstantModel.rationalCoefficients l E)) (K : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ.X X))) (_hK : constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ.X X K) {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (M : I ⥤ CochainComplex (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ.X X)) ℤ) (c : ℤ) (_hM : ∀ (i : I) (r : ℤ), r < c → IsZero ((M.obj i).X r)) : ∀ n : ℤ, Nonempty (IsColimit ((DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ (CondensedRing.derivedHom Λ.X X).obj (Opposite.op K) ⋙ DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).mapCocone (colimit.cocone M)))
lean.note: Equivalent cohomology-sheaf formulation expressly allowed by the node: for each degree the image of the termwise-colimit cocone under Q, the recorded closed internal Hom, and cohomology is a colimit cocone. Its legs are the canonical evaluation-induced maps; Nonempty IsColimit says their canonical comparison is an isomorphism.
